The policy says: Assignment history is attached to the person's account, not to their current role, so records previously assigned to someone moving to observer remain assigned to them and remain visible in that history; an observer role only changes what the person can do going forward, specifically that new work cannot be assigned to them and they cannot take actions requiring an agent or admin role. Also role change doesn't affect identity or history. So answer: yes, assignment history remains. Provide short answer.
